context: Request: the full list of matters handled for Cascade Retail Holdings Inc. (conflict check). Rubric: ten qualifying matters 1038-00001 to 1038-00010 plus a precision criterion; false hits come from the CRH abbreviation and other 'Cascade' entities.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review rates it partly reached and recommends re-listing per matter folder.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Attempt 2: a script prints every matter folder with its file count and all file paths (about 540K characters). The review asks for folder names and counts only.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). Prints only matter folder names and file counts (266 folders); the review says not to narrow to the numbered series it names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the client name and an abbreviation times out; the rerun in five matter-number ranges returns per-matter hits (about 79K characters). The review flags noisy abbreviation hits and unclear range completion.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: full-name-only scan with completion markers for every range; hits in ten matters of one numbered series. The review flags that the full-name filter could drop variants and that no hit matter was opened.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and closing or summary memos of all ten hit matters plus two abbreviation-hit matters. The review names five earlier-surfaced matters that were not opened.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads the engagement letters of the five named matters; none involves the client. The review accepts them as excluded.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the ten matters with roles, documents, method and exclusions. The review asks to re-check each matter and the aliases used.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks cited paths (one script fails on a bad file path); 45 paths found.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: expands ten shortened citations into full paths with edits and re-verifies 56 paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a two-level folder listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep for client-name words and an abbreviation, an empty content grep over all files, and a path walk; nine matters of one numbered series surface. The review flags the empty content grep.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of the ten matters in that numbered series, including the one with no name hit.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: lists files of 14 other matters that surfaced in the name search. The review notes the hand-typed set.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan for name variants (1,344 files), a heredoc error, then an exact-name scan returning about 290K characters. The review flags that 17 other hit matters were dismissed from snippets.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: narrow scan for the exact legal name grouped per matter; only the ten matters of the series hit. The review flags the narrow pattern.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads engagement letters and closing or substantive documents of all ten hit matters. The review flags a partial-listing pattern and one matter read without a closing document.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: store-wide grouped scan for the shorter client name; hits only in the ten matters. The review notes possible missed variants.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Reads one status tracker of a matter already settled on to confirm its posture.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the ten matters with scope, status, parties, documents and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths, expands shortened citations with ten edits (one check script fails on the path), re-reads it. The review accepts it.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a two-level folder listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep per client-name word (first 200 lines each) and a path walk; five matters of one numbered series surface. The review flags the line cap and the lack of a content search.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: lists files of the named candidates, a store-wide extraction scan that times out, and a store-wide path count; then a path walk adding abbreviation-named files of three more matters. The review flags the timed-out scan.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file names for request keywords (attempt 3). Extraction scan in matter-number batches saved to a file, then prints the hits of one numbered series (about 94K characters). The review flags that other hit matters were dismissed without a check.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared attempt 4. Path searches for the abbreviation and name words, an exact-name check over every non-series hit matter (zero files each) and two reads of one matter's engagement documents.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file names for request keywords (attempt 5). Exact-name extraction scan over all matter folders in batches (hits only in the ten series matters) alongside reads of the ten engagement letters. The review accepts the set.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads closing memos and governing agreements of nine of the ten matters. The review flags the one matter not opened and draft-only status for another.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2: lists files of three matters and reads their conflict memo, case memo, timeline and closing checklist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 3: reads a status email and executed or draft closing documents of the three matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the ten matters with roles, parties, status, documents, method and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths (one script fails on the path) and replaces shortened citations with edits.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads the opening of the response and five source documents to check role and status wording.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: reads the whole response and status sources of the remaining six matters; no change. The review accepts it.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: a store-wide extraction scan (rerun in matter-number ranges after a timeout) narrowed to the exact client name, which hits only one numbered series of ten matters; the engagement letter of each of the ten matters is read; other hit matters are checked and excluded; the response lists all ten, and check stages only fix citation paths. Reviews repeatedly asked for broader name variants and for opening other surfaced matters; following them added reads of non-client matters but never changed the set.
